leagues.name: Première Division (Ligue de N'Djamena)
leagues.note: Chad's effective top flight is organised as the Première Division de la Ligue de N'Djamena (the capital-region league that functions as the de facto national tier 1, per tracked sources); a separate 'Chad Premier League'/LINAFOOT national structure exists historically but a distinct current-season roster for it was not found. 9 clubs individually named for 2025-26 sharing the same home stadium/zone. FOLLOW-UP CHECK: a further search confirmed Gazelle, Renaissance, AS CotonTchad and Postel 2000 (all already in this list) are genuine past Chad Premier League/LINAFOOT title-winning clubs (4, 7, 2, and 2 titles respectively per Wikipedia/Grokipedia), and that the competition -- cancelled in 2024 -- resumed for 2025/26 under new FTFA leadership with '12 regionally diverse teams', consistent with N'Djamena-based clubs comprising the national top flight. This supports the existing 9 clubs as real, but a full current-season 12-club roster still could not be located, so verified=false is retained.
